source_discrepancies.meaning: 4P3U example depends on ANS grouping: 16 UTPs when four Fat Pipes specified versus four UTPs and four unused lanes under eight-lane example.
E18/E8/P4F/A4F uses A4F code unlisted in preceding Table13.3.2-2 50 protocol-code rows; no invented correction.
Depth/cooling/pitch example code menus wider than actual four supported dcp triples; do not assume arbitrary combinations.
Example 'required to auto-negotiate' descriptions do not have independent C239 Rule/SHALL labels; native standing distinct.
Printed odd/even UTP lane IDs sourced to external ANSI/VITA Table6.2.4.2-3, whose original normative text remains unread.

exact_holds.reason: C239 §13.3.3 explicitly delegates detailed AMPS and ANS syntax to ANSI/VITA 65.0 §§1.3.3.3.2/8.10; original ANSI/VITA clauses were not independently inspected.
Eight C239 DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI native companion files remain uninspected; AMPS physical syntax does not replace native software schemas.
Figure13.3.3-1 inline text and labels read but exact original high-resolution diagram geometry/pins not independently checked; page image retrieval/materialization unavailable.
Original ANSI/VITA 48.2/48.4/48.8 cooling and dimensional criteria not independently read; C239 source code values only.
Table13.3.3-2 E8/E18 example cells contain 'required to auto-negotiate' wording, not independently isolated C239 numbered Rules or proof of active runtime negotiation.
Table13.3.3-4 4P3U example references ANSI/VITA 65.0 Table6.2.4.2-3 odd/even UTP lane mapping; actual external source not reviewed.
4P3U means 16 UTPs for four-FP ANS example Table13.3.3-3, but four UTPs with four unused lanes for eight-lane ANS example Table13.3.3-4; no context-free equivalence.
Table13.3.3-2 E18/E8/P4F/A4F includes A4F whereas inspected Table13.3.2-2 code list has A3F/A5F/A6F; must preserve original discrepancy/unknown external ANSI evidence.
AMPS string parameter, count, Lkm modifier and dcp are hardware design identifiers, not default ISA custom data fields, SensorML schemas or CSAPI HTTP representation fields.
E18, E18~, auto-negotiation and PCIe width examples do not prove configured, connected, observed or dormant state of deployed equipment.
Source parameter j is omitted when no slot dash option; do not require every profile have j or aperture or treat dash as observed software version.
Table13.3.3-5 lists candidate code values, but Table13.3.3-6 supports only four depth/cooling/pitch combinations in C239; not arbitrary cross-product.
No original Dragino/AirGradient/Campbell/Bennett case evidence for specific AMPS profile, per-card port, real cooling, installed chassis or field Ethernet.
No real hardware PHY, handshaking, diagnostic, software command, OGC conformance or device configuration tested.
2025 The Open Group SOSA S251 and related future editions remain edition-distinct and uninspected; do not infer current options.
No universal DIM PICP chassis hierarchy, Profile SHALL, mandatory data field/cardinality or physical device control adopted.
§13.3.4 Payload AMPS Format begins on original PDF261; only boundary used, native content/tables not audited in G2-7B.
